description.value: An RV park in Taylor, a small Peace River town near Fort St. John; the 'Fairway' name suggests proximity to a golf course, but no further details are available from the fetched page.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook page was successfully fetched and provides the primary evidence. A May 2024 post explicitly states 'full hook ups, laundromat and coin operated showers,' confirming those amenities as current. The Facebook About section corroborates the OSM address (10034 100 St, Taylor, BC) and supplies a phone number (250-789-3794) and email absent from OSM, as well as a separate Google Business website URL not in OSM.
concerns: OSM lists no phone number; (250) 789-3794 was sourced solely from the Facebook About page.

Facebook About section lists a separate business website (https://fairway-rv-park-lodge.business.site/) not present in OSM; that site was not fetched and may be more authoritative than the Facebook URL.
